title: Oily Roasted Argentinian Sardine Bowl
description: A kid-friendly Argentinian dish featuring roasted sardines, nuka-pickle, and anti-inflammatory friendly ingredients, served in a Korean brass bowl.

ingredients.name: sardines
ingredients.notes: packed in water, drained and rinsed

instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Line a baking sheet with parchment paper and arrange the sardines in a single layer.
Drizzle the olive oil over the sardines and sprinkle with turmeric, ginger, garlic, salt, black pepper, and korean chili flakes.
Roast the sardines in the preheated oven for 12 minutes, or until cooked through.
Meanwhile, prepare the nuka-pickle according to the package instructions or homemade recipe.
In a Korean brass bowl, combine the roasted sardines, nuka-pickle, and chopped scallions.
Optional: garnish with additional chopped scallions and a sprinkle of korean chili flakes.
Note: this recipe is for refrigerator pickling/preserving only — store in the refrigerator and consume within 1 week. Do not water-bath can without an acid (vinegar or lemon juice).
